mapper.select:
select table_name, table_comment, create_time, update_time from information_schema.tables where table_schema = (select database()) AND table_name NOT LIKE 'qrtz\_%' AND table_name NOT LIKE 'gen\_%' AND table_name NOT IN (select table_name from gen_table)
SELECT t.table_name, c.comments AS table_comment, o.created AS create_time, o.last_ddl_time AS update_time FROM user_tables t LEFT JOIN user_tab_comments c ON t.table_name = c.table_name LEFT JOIN user_objects o ON t.table_name = o.object_name WHERE t.table_name NOT LIKE 'QRTZ_%' AND t.table_name NOT LIKE 'GEN_%' AND t.table_name NOT IN (SELECT table_name FROM gen_table)
SELECT t.table_name, COALESCE(pd.description, '') AS table_comment, -- Get the table comment, or return an empty string when absent '' AS create_time, -- Creation time cannot currently be retrieved directly '' AS update_time -- Update time cannot currently be retrieved directly FROM information_schema.tables t LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = t.table_name LEFT JOIN pg_description pd ON pd.objoid = c.oid WHERE t.table_schema = current_schema() -- Get the current session schema AND t.table_name NOT LIKE 'qrtz\_%' -- Exclude tables starting with 'qrtz_' AND t.table_name NOT LIKE 'gen\_%' -- Exclude tables starting with 'gen_' AND t.table_name NOT IN (SELECT table_name FROM gen_table) AND c.relkind = 'r' -- Query ordinary tables only (relkind r) AND pd.objsubid = 0 -- Get table comments only (objsubid=0 represents the object itself)
AND lower(table_name) LIKE lower('%' || #{tableName} || '%')
AND lower(table_comment) LIKE lower('%' || #{tableComment} || '%')
AND create_time >= #{params.beginTime}
AND create_time <= #{params.endTime}
AND lower(t.table_name) like lower(concat('%', #{tableName}, '%'))
AND lower(c.table_comment) like lower(concat('%', #{tableComment}, '%'))
AND date_format(t.create_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
AND date_format(t.create_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
order by create_time desc
